# Vendored dependencies

These directories are generated by `scripts/vendor_trystero.sh`; edit that script instead of the files.

- `trystero/`: [Trystero](https://github.com/dmotz/trystero) 0.26.0 (core + Nostr strategy), MIT license.
- `noble-secp256k1/`: [noble-secp256k1](https://github.com/paulmillr/noble-secp256k1) 3.2.0, MIT license.
